This week, Donald Trump kicked off America's 250th celebrations with a
[campaign-style rally](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/24/trump-
freedom-250-great-american-state-fair), declaring "America is back."

You've got to hand it to the president, perhaps America is back: Back to a
time when racism dictates policy; back to a time, when just a few ultra-rich
(white) men - whose wealth was built at least in part on corruption - hold all
the power; back to a time, when climate change wasn't acknowledged, much less
thought about. We could go on and on.

This year should be about celebrating American democracy - the progress the
U.S. has made, and recognizing the progress yet to come. But instead, it's a
reflection of the very worst of America.

Just this week, Trump and his cronies ramped up their efforts to [interfere
with elections](https://www.cnn.com/2026/06/22/politics/homeland-security-
grants-election-changes), [ended temporary protective
status](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/25/us/supreme-court-tps-ruling-
haitians-reaction.html) for hundreds of thousands of people, and [held
bipartisan legislation](https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2026/06/trump-
congress-housing-bill-elizabeth-warren.html) meant to lower housing costs
because… the president isn't getting his way on voter restrictions.

It was yet another week that exemplified the fascism that has defined Trump's
second term. Here's more about how Trump and his allies harmed democracy,
undermined the Constitution, and hurt societies worldwide this week:

#### **Saturday, June 20 - FBI Tried to Turn Delaney Hall Protesters Into
Informants**

The Intercept [reported](https://theintercept.com/2026/06/20/fbi-ice-delaney-
hall-protest-informants/) that at least half of the roughly 90 people who have
been arrested in recent weeks for protesting at the Delaney Hall ICE detention
center in New Jersey have been contacted by FBI agents who tried to get them
to become informants.

The move prompted a complaint by a deputy public defender representing
multiple protesters, who argued it violated the constitutional rights of his
clients.

#### **Sunday, June 21 - Trump Admin Quashed Criminal Investigation of
Clemency**

The _New York Times_
[reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/21/us/politics/trump-fraudster-
priest-investigation-brooklyn.html) that the Trump administration shut down a
criminal investigation into Trump's December 2025 commutation of the sentence
of David Gentile, a private equity executive who was convicted in 2024 of
securities and wire fraud charges in a case prosecutors described as a $1.6
billion scheme that defrauded thousands of investors.

As part of the probe into Gentile, who served less than two weeks of his
seven-year prison sentence, investigators learned about jailhouse
communications where he discussed making payments of $2.5 million or more to
people or companies to help secure his clemency.

#### **Monday, June 22 - Trump Ramps Up Efforts to Interfere in Elections**

CNN [reported](https://www.cnn.com/2026/06/22/politics/homeland-security-
grants-election-changes) that the Trump administration is threatening to
withhold tens of millions of dollars in federal Homeland Security funds to
states unless they make sweeping changes to their election laws, including
submitting their voter rolls through the DHS's citizenship verification
database.

The changes, which would be required under new rules for several homeland
security grant programs, would also force states to phase out certain
electronic voting systems and instead use hand-marked paper ballots.

#### **Tuesday, June 23 - Anti-ICE Protesters Get Up to 100 Years in Prison**

Federal judges
[gave](https://www.washingtonpost.com/nation/2026/06/23/alleged-antifa-
members-texas-get-maximum-sentences-ice-protest/) a group of anti-ICE
protesters, who were convicted for their roles in a 2025 demonstration in
Texas as alleged members of "antifa," prison sentences that ranged between 30
and 100 years. The person [who got 30 years](https://zeteo.com/p/prairieland-
sentences-anti-ice-protests-free-speech-trump) wasn't even at the protest. The
person who received 100 years was convicted of attempted murder, along with
other charges, after a police officer was shot and injured.

The landmark case marks the first to incorporate Trump's presidential
declaration that labeled "antifa" as a domestic terrorist organization
(antifa, which simply means "antifascist," is not an organization). The
protesters' sentences are notably longer than those given to Jan. 6
insurrectionists.

"The prosecution of the protesters is part of an increasingly disturbing
pattern of the Trump administration criminalizing speech and assembly in the
United States," **Zeteo** contributor Kim Wehle
[wrote](https://zeteo.com/p/prairieland-sentences-anti-ice-protests-free-
speech-trump). "And it should alarm us all."

#### **Wednesday, June 24 - Trump Holds Housing Bill Hostage**

On Truth Social, Trump abruptly
[canceled](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/116805545512296111)
the signing of a bipartisan bill designed to lower the cost of housing until
the Republican-led House and Senate pass the [SAVE America
Act](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-save-america-
elections?utm_campaign=23956408708&utm_source=google_ads&utm_medium=cpc&utm_content=-&utm_term=&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=23946692121&gbraid=0AAAAA-F9BazC_KrgXZqeyNS2kPZ6mwvyd&gclid=EAIaIQobChMI37vHoOKilQMVDVJHAR1f3yt9EAAYASAAEgI1TfD_BwE),
which would disenfranchise millions of voters by requiring proof of
citizenship and photo ID to cast a ballot in elections.

Trump [doesn't have](https://time.com/article/2026/06/24/trump-housing-bill-
save-america-act-voting-restrictions/) much leverage to hold the bill hostage,
as legislation can still become law 10 days after it's presented to the
president while Congress is in session. Additionally, the bill received enough
support from Congress that lawmakers could override a veto by the president if
he tries to do so.

#### **Thursday, June 25 - Supreme Court Allows Trump to End TPS for Haitians,
Syrians**

The Supreme Court [cleared the
way](https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/25pdf/25-1083_f204.pdf) for the
Trump administration to remove the Temporary Protected Status of roughly
350,000 Haitians and 6,000 Syrians, in a move that will require them to leave
the country or risk being arrested and deported once a termination date is
set.

In the ruling, Justice Samuel Alito concluded that the TPS law authorizes
Trump to end the program without intervention from the courts, a finding that
threatens protections for people from the other 15 countries under the
program.

#### **Friday, June 26 - Hundreds of Thousands of Children Have No Lawyer for
Deportation Hearings**

Drop Site [reported](https://www.dropsitenews.com/p/children-attorneys-
immigration-court-deportation?utm_source=post-email-
title&publication_id=2510348&post_id=203534721&utm_campaign=email-post-
title&isFreemail=true&r=16n89&triedRedirect=true&utm_medium=email) that more
than half of the over 750,000 children facing deportation hearings have no
legal representation, according to data from the Justice Department's
Executive Office for Immigration Review.  
  
The rate of children navigating immigration court proceedings without a lawyer
(57%) is slightly higher than the 54% of adults who are unrepresented in their
cases.
